text: Two ways. (1) In the Claude app, open this session (acct-5d1e2d (mirage)) and approve the prompt when it asks about the push to cloud-config. If it only shows a denial, the session is in auto mode, so switch it to ask-for-permission and tell me to retry. (2) Permanent: add an allow rule for pushing to the cloud-config branch to the permissions list in the repo's .claude/settings.json, then tell me. I won't edit my own permissions, since that's your call. Once allowed I'll apply the three bid settings and set the engine to restart on schedule.
